result.topic_en: Draft of a referee report on a submitted treatise on cycloids and the general theory of rolling curves (with a pencil draft of a covering letter to a professor), together with scattered congruences mod 8n+4 and integral formulas involving ds/Δ with a², b², c² (ellipsoid-type integrals).
